title: Keep several numbers
summary: R: Keep several numbers. Add another score.
introduction: A vector is an ordered group of values. c combines values into a vector.

blocks.text: Install R. Save an example as lesson.R and run Rscript lesson.R, or paste it into the R console.
c combines three values into one vector. cat separates displayed values with spaces.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: R positions start at 1, unlike many other languages.
